result.description: NQ POWER EQUIPMENT PTY LTD  The successful applicant will be responsible for servicing, diagnosing, repairing and maintaining a wide range of outdoor power equipment and small engines.  Duties and Responsibilities   Diagnose faults on petrol and diesel powered outdoor power equipment.  Service and repair ride-on mowers, zero-turn mowers, chainsaws, brushcutters, generators, pumps and other small engine equipment.  Perform engine rebuilds and component replacement where required.  Use diagnostic equipment and manufacturer service information to identify mechanical faults.  Complete servicing in accordance with manufacturer specifications.  Maintain accurate service records and job documentation.  Ensure all work is completed safely and to a high standard.  Assist customers with technical advice where required.  Maintain a clean and organised workshop.    Benefits  At NQ Power Equipment Pty Ltd, we value our employees and are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding workplace. As part of our team, you will receive:   Competitive salary of  AUD $75,000–$85,000 plus superannuation , depending on skills and experience.  Full-time, permanent employment with long-term career opportunities.  Ongoing manufacturer and industry training to further develop your technical skills.  A modern, well-equipped workshop with quality tools and equipment.  The opportunity to work on a wide range of leading outdoor power equipment brands.  A supportive and friendly team environment that values safety, quality workmanship and professional development.  Opportunities for career progression as the business continues to grow.    Task & responsibilities  The successful applicant will be responsible for servicing, diagnosing, repairing and maintaining a wide range of outdoor power equipment and small engines. Duties will include:   Diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults using appropriate testing and diagnostic equipment.  Servicing, repairing and overhauling petrol and diesel-powered small engines.  Maintaining and repairing ride-on mowers, zero-turn mowers, chainsaws, brushcutters, hedge trimmers, generators, pumps and other outdoor power equipment.  Replacing or repairing worn, damaged or faulty components, including engines, transmissions, fuel systems, ignition systems, hydraulic systems and electrical components.  Performing scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance in accordance with manufacturer specifications.  Testing equipment after repairs to ensure safe operation and compliance with manufacturer standards.  Accurately recording repair details, parts used and service documentation.  Maintaining a clean, safe and organised workshop environment in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements.  Providing professional technical advice to customers regarding the operation and maintenance of equipment.  Working effectively as part of the workshop team to deliver high-quality workmanship and excellent customer service.    Qualification & experience  To be successful in this role, applicants should possess:   A recognised trade qualification as a  Small Engine Mechanic ,  Motor Mechanic , or an equivalent qualification relevant to the role.  A minimum of one  year relevant post-qualification experience , or an equivalent combination of formal training and relevant work experience.  Demonstrated experience diagnosing, servicing and repairing a wide range of petrol and diesel-powered outdoor power equipment, including ride-on mowers, zero-turn mowers, chainsaws, brushcutters, generators and pumps.  Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills, with the ability to interpret technical manuals and manufacturer specifications.  Experience using workshop diagnostic equipment, specialised tools and safe workshop practices.  A commitment to producing high-quality workmanship and delivering excellent customer service.  The ability to work independently, manage workloads efficiently and contribute positively within a team environment.  A current driver's licence is preferred.   About Company    NQ Power Equipment Pty Ltd is a leading outdoor power equipment sales and service centre based in Innisfail, North Queensland. We are an authorised dealer and service agent for leading brands including Bushranger, Hustler, Gravely, Kawasaki, Shindaiwa, Stiga, Masport and Cox. Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced Small Engine Mechanic to join our workshop team. Specialising in offering quality vehicles from established brands, our team is always committed to providing an unparalleled automotive experience for our customers. We are currently looking to recruit multiple experienced and qualified Motor Mechanic to join our teams throughout Brighton VIC.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Removing rough spots on vehicle panels
-  Sanding surfaces by hand and with power sanders
-  Masking areas not to be painted with tape and paper
-  Color matching and mixing paints to match paint shades, and selecting pre-mixed paint
-  Applying primer and finishing coats using spray-guns, and sanding surfaces between coats
-  Touching up paintwork and applying polish to vehicles
-  Removing masking papers, and waxing and polishing finished paintwork
-  Painting signs and artwork on vehicles
-  Treating vehicles with rust-proofing chemicals

Skills & Abilities:

-  Process-oriented logical thinker
-  Good hand-eye coordination
-  Strong attention to detail
-  Bring a positive attitude to work.
-  Meeting Body & Paint standards.
-  Maintain Quality standards and minimize re-work.
-  Finish all jobs in a timely manner.

Multiple Full-time Position available

result.description:
Phillip Riley are searching for an Electrical Engineering Technician to assist in the maintenance of plant, as well as the planning and implementing of maintenance strategies and improvements within the technical environment.

Your Responsibilities

As part of your new role you will be responsible for tasks such as:

prepares drawings, plans, and diagrams of electrical installations, circuits and stations
assisting Engineers and Engineering Team with design and layout of electrical installations on infrastructure such as substations, switches, cabling systems and motor control systems
The planning and supervision of preventative maintenance of our manufacturing machines and tools
Executing the designed improvements by installation and/or fabrication of those plans
Keeping track and ordering necessary consumables and materials while considering the budget put in place
Working together with onsite Installers for any alterations needed of installation equipment or tools
Assembly, Testing, Updates and Monitoring of all electrical equipment and ensuring legal and safety requirements are met.
Installation of assemblies for protection relays, metering and monitoring devices
About you
